boundary_license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0
attribution: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
acquisition: runtime, explicitly authorized current viewport or Esri-geocoded user-named place, at most 16 tiles
repository_imagery_policy: Runtime imagery pixels are not committed; only source metadata and the product Demo are tracked.
method: bounded RGB colour-dominance and edge heuristics
limitations: Visual screening only; not radiometrically calibrated source imagery.
Tile dates and sensors may vary within one view.
Pixel shares are not geodesic areas.
No multispectral indices or temporal change detection are performed.
OpenStreetMap boundaries are real community-maintained polygons, not an official or legal boundary source.
